method: Agent visual inspection of four rendered Playwright captures using view_image
findings: Arabic mobile restart explanation and stacked before/after approval routes fit the captured panel.
English desktop correction preserves requested quantities, highlights changed qualifications and revision, and shows the reason.
Arabic retained Board history distinguishes the original principal from the actual decision member and recorder, with supporting-document link.
English no-change history states that no new revision or approval restart occurred.
limits: Four focused captures inspected; not an independent accessibility audit, full-screen design review or HR terminology sign-off.
